race.comment: SASQUA (2) is back for a second campaign off a seven-month spell. All three runs in the maiden prep had merit although all of them were at 1200m or further. Trialled well recently and looks set for a positive return. GOT HERE (5) charged home late to get up for third over this trip at Muswellbrook in August, his only start to date. Draws the coveted inside alley and with some improvement likely over the break he comes right under notice. PLUME (6) led and gave a kick but was nailed near the line last start over this course and distance in a Class 1. Drawn poorly but if she can cross she is a big chance back in maiden company. Sandbar three-year-old ROCKBARTON BEACH (7) is a first starter from the David Atkins stable. Looked good taking out a recent Gosford trial and has been well found in early markets. Stablemate ROCKBARTON GRIT (8) is also on debut and showed enough in the latest trial to suggest he can run a bit of a race.
